title: Act 6 (Parts 1–3) — The Real Game Beneath the Headlines: Pressure, Talent and the Physical Ceiling
ledger: Elon's DealBook praise and the TerraFab idea were calculated for effect on NVIDIA's boardroom; NVIDIA's interim leadership faces falling stock and hyperscalers replacing GPUs with custom ASICs; the board fears losing Jensen-loyal chip architects and its most aggressive buyer, Elon
Headlines over a chessboard, DealBook shockwave, interim hot seat, board's two fears

Dangling a $119B Texas megafab gives Elon three wins without a contract: pressure on NVIDIA's interim leadership while negotiating Vera Rubin terms, a talent magnet for TerraFab, and a signal to engineers that he is serious about a rival to TSMC
Keys, negotiation table, engineers queue, engineers drawn by Jensen's name

The physical ceiling (ASML scanner queues, TSMC advanced packaging, gigawatts of power) governs everyone; TerraFab's Texas site must build its own power and water; the threat of a Musk-Huang alliance is almost as powerful as the alliance itself
Three doors under one ceiling, choke points, power and water, balance scale
cues: The real game beneath the headlines
